what: The originating branch-stacked SSF topology (bridge + current reuse) ported to IHP SG13G2 by device TYPE and SIZE only -- all 42 device connections identical to the drawn topology. Measured in this repo on the frozen definitions in lab.metrics. Sizing is layout-legal: 5 nm grid, PDK minimum widths, <=10 um gate fingers (lab.grid.legalize + lab.retune.restore_fc).
notes: All of S1-S8 pass. Best cell in the repo on every spec axis.
THD at the S7 point (-56.46 dB) BEATS the certified reference (-48.37 dB).
NOT supply-tolerant: fc 250.0 -> 206.5 Hz at VDD 1.45 V. Proven unfixable by device type or size -- see signoff/README.md.
In-band THD above 100 Hz remains ~15 dB behind the reference (one shared ladder current cannot serve both internal-node bandpass peaks).
